evidence: For a round trip, continue on the Pillar Point Lighthouse Track (a 4WD track) to Wharariki Road (30 min) and return to the car park via Wharariki Road (1 hr).

doubts: Pillar Point Lighthouse is given the coast name Pillar Point (T5). The Pillar Point Lighthouse car park is taken as F4 (where Pillar Point Lighthouse Track meets Wharariki Road), which is inferred rather than stated. Cape Farewell car park has no matching feature. The main way can also be walked back the same track or along Wharariki Road; it is recorded as one way per DOC's 'one way' time and distance.
